data.name: Penelope
data.gender_notes: Penelope is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek pēnē, 'thread, weft' — 'weaver'. Its root is Greek pēnē (πήνη). Penelope, wife of Odysseus; a classical name. Penelope is a Greek name meaning “Weaver; (also) duck”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Penelope expresses “Weaver; (also) duck”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Penelope total 43, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
